# Sources

Every resource used must be cited (Space Apps rule). `id` is how the data files and [relationships.md](relationships.md) refer to each source.

## Read first

- `hazards` — [NASA – 5 Hazards of Human Spaceflight](https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazards)
- `immrisk` — [NASA Immune Risk page (incl. Immune Risk DAG)](https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/immune-risk/)
- `crucian18` — [Crucian et al. 2018 – Immune System Dysregulation During Spaceflight (Front. Immunol.)](https://frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2018.01437/full)
